current_evidence: Fenland consulted on a single consolidated 'Draft Local Validation List' (23 Sep to 14 Oct 2024, fendc1-prd.gosshosted.com/locallist2024), replacing the separate per-application-type PF lists. A council report titled 'Adoption of Local Validation List' (fenland.gov.uk/localgov/documents/s16054) shows it went for adoption, but both that report and the adopted PDF could not be fetched within budget.

issues.detail: The workbook links PF04 'Planning permission', one of the old per-application-type validation PDFs (PF01-PF11, uploaded around 2023). Fenland has since replaced these with a single consolidated Local Validation List: consulted on in autumn 2024, and the subject of a committee report titled 'Adoption of Local Validation List'. Grokbot's own scraped planning-page text mentions 'The Council's Local Validation List (PDF, 437 KB) sets out the general requirements', yet the workbook did not use that document.
issues.evidence: Consultation notice: 'The list is now a single consolidated document instead of separate lists for each application type'; consultation closed 5pm 14 October 2024

issues.detail: The workbook URL returned a client error on fetch, so it may have been removed. The planning forms page (fenland.gov.uk/planningforms) still names the PF01-PF11 forms but did not expose working links to these PDFs.

The 'List date' 2024-07-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate), not document text. The PF PDFs' URL timestamps (m=6381429969...) correspond to early 2023, and the consolidated list replacing them dates from late 2024 or later, so July 2024 matches neither.

Tab items include the invalid-application administration charge (fees table, e.g. 'Householder £26.99 Three...', 'Processing invalid applications takes considerable time and resources'), website navigation text ('National and Local List requirements (PDF, 437 KB) PF05 Specific Guidance (Word doc...)') and repeated 'Do not scale' fragments. These are fees, process text and boilerplate, not requirements.

'Schedule of works (listed building)' is listed under Householder, presumably taken from the PF03 Householder + listed building form, but it applies only to listed building works. Full planning rows are mostly marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Several requirements captured under Householder (Health Impact, Retail Impact, Telecoms) appear only under Full planning, while the reverse placements could not be verified against the source.

Many trigger excerpts start with fragments of the preceding policy citation (e.g. 'Plan 2014.  Biodiversity Checklist/Report...', 'National Planning Policy Framework 2021.  Photographs...'). The Travel Plan trigger gives no threshold ('Please visit the website below for when a travel plan is required'). The NPPF 2021 references show the source predates the current list.

summary: The workbook relies on Fenland's old per-application-type PF validation PDFs (the linked PF04 now fails to load), but Fenland consulted on and moved to adopt a single consolidated Local Validation List from late 2024. The current list could not be fetched to check contents; the captured items include fees and navigation text.
